short_overview: 3PPROFIL is a French company located in the Haute Loire department, specializing in the extrusion of recycled plastics for 20 years. 3P Profil markets tubes, profiles, angles, and mandrels and has solid experience in the extrusion of polyolefins (HDPE, LDPE, PP), PVC, styrenics (PS, ABS), as well as plant-based materials. We have been ISO9001 certified since 2021, LABELMORE since 2019, and received the innovation trophy in 2022. We are currently preparing for ISO14001 and ECOVADIS certifications. 3PPROFIL is committed to an ecological approach and continuously improves its material processing processes. All of our waste is reintegrated into our manufacturing. Our primary ambition is to recycle and give a second life to the materials used in the production of food bricks. Thus, we transform this recycled material, called POLYAL, into profiles and sections dedicated to the manufacture of urban furniture. We also offer garden borders and privacy slats. All of our products ensure the homogeneity and quality of urban spaces without maintenance constraints or degradation related to climate change. This 100% recycled and 100% recyclable material has remarkable characteristics: it is rot-proof, durable, maintenance-free, non-toxic, and non-conductive.

Spent grain flour also brings entirely new flavors and a natural coloration from the grains that make up the spent grains. We offer three variations, as with beer, it will be blonde, ambrée, or brune, thus providing unique flavors for each of these flours: cereal, caramelized, or roasted. short_overview: For over 30 years, MAFDEL has been manufacturing a wide range of thermoweldable belts and conveyor belts for various industries. Very easy to join on-site using simple tools, these belts and conveyor belts simplify maintenance and reduce production downtime. The round, trapezoidal, flat, or special belts made from polyurethane or polyester elastomer exhibit very high resistance to abrasion, cuts and tears, oils, greases, and solvents, and comply with food standards. The absence of fabric and the complete impermeability of the materials allow for a reduction in bacterial proliferation and more economical cleaning. The new range of positive drive belts combines the advantages of monomaterial belts and modular belts without the risk of slipping. Particularly suitable for the food industry, they can be equipped with accessories: lugs, edges, and others.

short_overview: Vescera is a historic company that has been transforming and enhancing Sicilian grains since 1890, producing high-quality organic pasta entirely made in Sicily. The company exclusively selects, cultivates, and transforms ancient Sicilian grains, ensuring a short, controlled, and sustainable supply chain. Vescera pasta is made with only two ingredients: water and semolina from organic ancient Sicilian grains, without additives or chemicals. We use three prized native varieties: Russello (also known as Rossello, Ruscio, or Russieddru), Tumminia (Timillia, formerly Tûmìnia Nigra), and Perciasacchi (known as Buca Sacchi or Farro Lungo). These grains give the pasta a superior nutritional profile, an authentic taste, and high digestibility. The processing follows traditional methods: the pasta is bronze-drawn and slowly dried at low temperatures, preserving all the nutritional and organoleptic characteristics typical of Sicilian grains. Every phase of production and packaging takes place in the facility in Corleone, in the province of Palermo, confirming the strong connection to the territory. Vescera semolinas are free from pesticides, mycotoxins, and contaminants, fully respecting the highest standards of quality and food safety. The company proudly carries on a sustainable organic farming tradition passed down through generations, which protects biodiversity and enhances the oldest cereal varieties of the island.

short_overview: We utilize our original microbial technologies, and propose products, develop new products, and provide technical consulting. We provide the following: [1] Recycling agricultural and livestock production system connecting regions by BC bacteria (E&BC recycling agricultural and livestock production system) BC bacteria are our original microbial inoculant. For details, see our website (http://www.ctb.ne.jp/~biocycle/index.html) (same link as on this page). This system uses four bio-technologies: 1) lactic acid-fermented feed effectively utilizing regional byproducts, 2) bio-deodorized livestock-raising barn using BC deodorant bacteria, 3) high-concentration organic waste liquid treatment by an alkaline bio-treatment, and 4) odor-free compost produced by an excreta treatment system using BC fermentation bacteria. The E&BC recycling agricultural and livestock production system uses these four bio-technologies. It is a recycling agricultural and livestock production system which improves the feed self-sufficiency rate. It also creates an odor-free barn for raising livestock, eliminates liquid waste from livestock facilities, and completes the recycling of organic matter by changing excreta sludge into compost by BC bacteria. We provide direct guidance throughout the year so that even persons with no expertise in microbes can operate the system. Lactic acid-fermented feed effectively utilizing regional byproducts: We use BC bacteria which assist lactic acid fermentation, and make silage by utilizing the byproduct of each region’s staple crop, thus achieving self-sufficient feed procurement in each town or village. Our technologies are applicable to shochu waste liquids, bean-curd refuse and various other regional byproducts. Note 1: Silage is feed obtained by packing soiling forage crops into a silo to cause lactic acid fermentation. Note 2: A byproduct is a substance which is secondarily produced when producing something. Bio-deodorized livestock-raising barn using BC deodorant bacteria: BC bacteria contain our original thermophilic actinomycetes as main bacteria, and effectively removes foul odors. By spraying BC bacteria, the odor of livestock-raising facilities is reduced, and the BOD standard value can be complied with. By installing a bacteria spray system in a livestock-raising barn and regularly spraying BC bacteria where odors are strong, the influence of foul odors in the region can be minimized. Note: BOD is an abbreviation for biochemical oxygen demand. It expresses the amount of organic matter, etc. in water, in terms of the amount of oxygen required by microbes to oxidatively degrade them. Water quality deteriorates as BOD value increases. High-concentration organic waste liquid treatment by alkaline bio-treatment: Among waste liquids in the livestock industry, those from raising barns are especially concentrated. We use thermophilic bacteria of the BC bacteria group, and can reduce contamination to about one twentieth in just two days. By reducing the contamination of waste liquids in this way, the overall facilities can be simplified, and measures for complying with water quality regulations can be taken. Odor-free compost produced by an excreta treatment system using BC fermentation bacteria: It is known that compost fermentation is accelerated when BC bacteria are added (see [2] BC compost manufacturing). BC bacteria can also suppress foul odors due to ammonia from fermentation tanks. These functions of BC bacteria enable odor-free manufacturing of completely fermented compost. The compost manufactured in this way can be returned to farmers who produce the staple crops of the region. By using these technologies, it is possible to improve the feed self-sufficiency rate, solve the problems of foul odors and waste liquids from livestock-raising barns, and convert excreta sludge into BC bacteria compost, thus achieving the recycling of organic matter in each region. [2] BC compost manufacturing We use BC bacteria to manufacture compost. For this, we use BC thermophilic actinomycetes, BC thermophilic cellulose-decomposing bacteria, and BC photosynthetic bacteria as the main types of bacteria, and produce high-quality compost in a short time. We provide technical guidance and sell BC bacteria, and enable the production of high-quality compost in a short time. [3] Assistance in new product development using fermentation technologies Using our original fermentation technologies, we have assisted the development of many new products (see the page on joint research & development). We assist in the development of fermented food manufacturing methods, in addition to assisting the manufacturing of compost. Please feel free to contact us.

short_overview: Ordinary buildings use 48% of their energy for air conditioning and ventilation, and 34% of this is lost through ventilation. Most buildings have negative pressure inside, because current ventilation systems are mainly for exhaust purposes. Negative-pressure buildings are affected by outdoor air penetrating through every opening, and their internal temperatures are always linked with outdoor air temperatures. Room cooling or heating consequently reaches a peak when the outdoor air temperature reaches a peak. The simultaneous use of air conditioners boosts power demand. Factories, buildings with kitchens, and smoking rooms, which have a large amount of air volume displacement, lose air conditioning because of the same kind of difficulties. Our company studied a new ventilation method jointly with a university to minimize the volume of air coming into and going out of buildings while maintaining ventilation performance. This is how we developed our Wind Navi system as a forced substitution and ventilation method to artificially produce powerful indoor push-pull air currents flowing toward ventilation ports. We make proposals for power saving, energy saving, and cost reduction based on this new technology to reduce air-conditioning energy attributable to ventilation. Our company is devoted to changing the internal pressures of buildings to positive air pressure to improve the indoor environment by preventing insects, dust, and drafts. We have a track record of proving great power saving, energy saving, and operation cost reduction effects in many cases. Blow rate reduction will allow smaller equipment for treating oil soot, smells, and other harmful components in exhaust. Exhaust reduction has also been proven to greatly reduce processing costs.

PetsFish is a HACCP-implemented, EU veterinary approved pet food producer operating under Category 3 animal by-products regulations. EU export certificates are available. Continuous efforts to improve production processes reflect a commitment to reducing environmental impact while maintaining efficiency.

A new bamboo plant is mature enough to be harvested in three to six years, depending on the species. The most important thing is that bamboo is renewable. Unlike hardwood trees, bamboo regrows after harvesting, just like grass regrows after mowing. Once mature, bamboo can be harvested every year for the lifespan of the plant. Pick up in store? Bioclimatization is the process of climate control through the evaporation of water. Bioclimatization uses the same cooling system that occurs in nature near water bodies: the breeze by the sea, at waterfalls, lakes... Due to a physical principle of nature, water tends to evaporate, absorbing energy from the surrounding air, which consequently lowers its temperature. Bioclimatization equipment optimizes this natural process through technological innovation. Using a pump, water is circulated through a distributor that moistens high-performance filters. These filters are designed to enhance the air cooling capacity as it passes through them. This air is propelled by a centrifugal fan, achieving a high airflow rate, combined with low energy consumption and a quiet operating level. All of this consumes similar energy to that of a fan and is up to 80% less than that of a conventional air conditioning system. It is the perfect system for climate control in industrial buildings, workshops, and warehouses. In industrial environments, heat poses a serious problem for companies. Labor regulations require reducing heat and maintaining worker spaces at less than 27°C. Additionally, heat affects numerous types of products and is a frequent cause of breakdowns by minimizing the performance of machinery in industrial facilities.
